meta.warning: MAINTAINER ACTION REQUIRED: no value in this file has been checked against an official World Archery rulebook. Before shipping a competitive build, verify every number against the current Book 3 (Target Archery) and the current competition-format book, record the edition in meta.rulebook.edition, set meta.rulebook.verified to true, and sign it with verifiedBy/verifiedOn. The rules engine refuses to advertise a 'verified' ruleset until that flag is set, and the UI shows an 'unofficial values' badge while it is false.
meta._provenance: Values marked with a '_verify' key are the ones most likely to change between rulebook editions.

fieldOfPlay._verify: laneWidthM/minLaneWidthM follow the brief (80 cm minimum). The 122 cm face needs roughly 2.5 m of lateral room per lane at 70 m; confirm the organiser's layout standard before changing.
fieldOfPlay._provenance: Book 3, field of play chapters; organiser layout guidance

wa122.label: 122 cm face (10 rings)
wa122._verify: Ring width 6.1 cm and X-ring 6.1 cm diameter are the standard 122 cm face geometry; confirm printing tolerances in Book 3.

wa80.label: 80 cm face (rings 5-10)
wa80._verify: Compound uses the 80 cm 6-ring face at 50 m. Rings 1-4 are not printed; an arrow outside the 5 ring is a miss on that face.

wa40_6.label: 40 cm 6-ring triple spot
wa40_6._verify: Indoor compound triple spot: three 40 cm 6-ring faces stacked vertically. Confirm the accepted configuration for the event entered.

recurve.name: Recurve (Olympic)
recurve.description: 70 m, 122 cm face. Linear draw force curve, clicker, pin sight and long rod. Finger release.
recurve._verify: 70 m / 122 cm is the Olympic recurve outdoor round. Draw weight and speed ranges are equipment-realistic ranges, not rulebook values.

compound.name: Compound
compound.description: 50 m, 80 cm 6-ring face. Cam-shaped force curve with 80% let-off, peep + scope, mechanical release aid, very fast arrows.
compound._verify: 50 m / 80 cm face is the standard compound outdoor round. Let-off 75-85% is equipment-realistic and must remain inside the division's equipment rules.

barebow.name: Barebow
barebow.description: 50 m, 122 cm face. No sight and no stabiliser: string picture, anchor and gap aiming only.
barebow._verify: Barebow distance and face are the brief's defaults; some federations run 50 m on the 122 cm face for the barebow division. Confirm the division rules for the event entered.

rankingRound.name: 72-arrow ranking round
rankingRound.description: 12 ends of 6 arrows at the division distance. Cumulative score seeds the elimination bracket; X count breaks ties.

recurveMatch.name: Recurve individual match (set system)
recurveMatch.description: Up to 5 sets of 3 arrows. 2 set points for a set win, 1 for a draw, 0 for a loss. First to 6 set points wins; 5-5 goes to a single-arrow shoot-off.

compoundMatch.name: Compound individual match (cumulative)
compoundMatch.description: 15 arrows in 5 ends of 3, cumulative score. Ties go to a single-arrow shoot-off.

barebowMatch.name: Barebow individual match
barebowMatch.description: Barebow matches use the configured scoring style (set system by default, cumulative optional).

indoor18.name: 18 m indoor round
indoor18.description: 60 arrows, 20 ends of 3, 40 cm face (triple spot optional for compound).

practice.name: Practice
practice.description: Free shooting at any configured distance. No time limit, no penalties; optional training overlays.

team.name: Team (3 archers)
team.description: 3 archers, 2 arrows each per end, 4 ends. Optional later stage.

mixedTeam.name: Mixed team (1 man + 1 woman)
mixedTeam.description: 2 archers, 2 arrows each per end, 4 ends. Optional later stage.

timing._verify: 4 minutes for 6 arrows (ranking) and 20 seconds per arrow (match play) follow the brief. The yellow warning is 30 s in ranking and 10 s in match play; confirm both against the current rulebook and the event's local rules.

buzzer.start: two short buzzes when the green light appears
buzzer.warning: one short buzz at the yellow light
buzzer.end: one long buzz when time expires

signals._verify: Signal colours and buzzer pattern follow the brief (red/green/yellow with buzzer). Confirm the exact sound and light sequence for the event.

penalties.earlyRelease: An arrow shot before the signal is not counted; the highest scoring arrow of that end is cancelled.
penalties.lateRelease: An arrow shot after the signal has expired is not counted; the highest scoring arrow of that end is cancelled.
penalties.description: Where the local rules differ, change these strings and the cancelHighestArrowOfEnd flag: the rules engine reads them at runtime.
penalties._verify: Penalty wording and the 'cancel the highest arrow' remedy follow the brief; confirm against Book 3 (shooting procedure / penalties).

scoring.robinHood: An arrow embedded in another arrow's nock (Robin Hood) is scored by the arrow it struck, and both arrows count as shot; a broken shaft is withdrawn.
scoring.passThrough: An arrow that passes through the face is re-shot if it left a mark that cannot be scored, subject to the judge's decision.
scoring.bounceBack: An arrow that rebounds from the face is re-shot, subject to the judge's decision.
scoring._verify: Line cutting is judged on the outer edge of the shaft; the automatic scorer uses defaultShaftDiameterMm. judgeReviewRadiusMm is a game-design tolerance for close calls, not a rulebook value.

procedures._verify: Alternating order and the walk-to-the-target procedure are the standard outdoor flow. Confirm timing and practice-end counts for the specific event.
